jobs.title: Lead Product Manager, Customer Portal
jobs.description:
About Customer Portal

Customer Portal exists to make Veriff's product sell itself. The Portal serves two purposes. It allows our customers to operate Veriff products — setting up and configuring products, consulting verification session details, reporting issues. And it is a privileged surface for customers to discover, try, buy and expand through a seamless self-serve experience, connecting product usage, onboarding and growth in one place. It unites forces with GTM to automate acquisition, upsell, cross-sell and retention, with end-to-end ownership of the customer persona. The area is evolving fast. What began as a self-serve growth surface (Station) is becoming the customer-facing window into Veriff's accuracy and fraud advantage for our largest enterprise customers.

The shape of this role

This is an IC-first leadership role, and the first genuine step into product leadership — distinct from a strong senior IC. At first you will lead through craft, authority and influence. You own the strategy, discovery, roadmap and delivery for your product area.

As you refine the strategic themes for this large product, we expect you to propose the team configuration needed to support our growth and company objectives. That will move you progressively from IC to manager, while retaining hands-on ownership of at least one part of the Customer Portal area in the mid-term. We will deliberately assess for both the IC craft bar and the latent management capability, because the role is designed to traverse the line.

What you will do

- Own the product strategy and roadmap for the Customer Portal area, tied explicitly to Veriff's commercial model and revenue drivers.

- Run disciplined, continuous discovery with customers, and translate it into well-defined problem statements and a sequenced roadmap.

- Make transparent prioritisation and trade-off calls across product ambition, technical sustainability and business urgency — especially where capability gaps mean we cannot do everything at once.

- Define success metrics before building, and hold the team accountable to outcomes, not output.

- Partner as a credible peer to Engineering, GTM, Fraud Ops and Design. Be the connective tissue that turns internal expertise into a customer-facing product.

- Own launch as a discipline from the start — internal platform releases and external GTM — not a milestone at the end.

- Set and uphold the product-craft bar. Mentor PMs and, in time, build and lead the team.

- Champion AI internally, implementing new best practices for faster product discovery and delivery.

Who you are

You are a product leader who has earned authority through the quality of your thinking rather than a title.

You have owned a product area end-to-end

- From strategy through discovery, delivery and launch. You are equally comfortable in the messy front end of a problem and in the discipline of shipping.

- You are looking for the step where your impact starts to come through others, and you are excited that this role begins as an individual leader and grows into managing a team — not the other way around.

You think commercially

- You instinctively connect what you build to how the business grows, and you explain the “why” behind a product bet in terms of revenue, retention and customer trust, not just features and flows.

You run discovery as a continuous discipline

- You get close to customers, including demanding enterprise accounts, and you can tell the difference between what they ask for and what they actually need.

- You turn that into sharp problem statements and a phased roadmap where every step delivers a real customer outcome.

You prioritise ruthlessly and transparently

- When there are more good ideas than capacity, you make the hard calls about what not to do, and you can articulate the reasoning.

- You define success before you build. When something goes wrong, you own it without deflection and change how you work as a result.

You lead through influence, not authority

- You build credibility with engineering, go-to-market, design and operations partners as a genuine peer, and you reach good decisions with people who do not report to you.

- You stay calm under uncertainty, create space for views that differ from your own, and commit gracefully once a call is made.

You raise the people around you

- You set a high craft bar through your own work, share your thinking generously and give specific, useful feedback.

- You are motivated by building and leading a team over time, with a realistic understanding that management is a different job — one focused on developing people and multiplying impact, not doing all the work yourself.

You stay current on your craft

- You take pride in tracking how product management is evolving, and you consistently find time to experiment and fold what works into your practice.

Why Veriff?

We are the preferred identity verification platform partner for the world’s most innovative growth-driven organizations helping conveniently verify and safeguard users anywhere in the world. We support the broadest number of identity documents from nearly every country and territory in the world - and this is continually increasing! With a diverse team in the United States, United Kingdom, Spain, and Estonia, as well as robust backing and funding from investors including Accel, Alkeon, IVP, Tiger Capital, and Y Combinator, we’re dedicated to helping businesses and individuals build a safer and more secure world. We strive to be the benchmark for trust online, and we take pride in being a positive force.When you join Team Veriff, we offer you the opportunity to have a real impact and advance your career whilst looking after you along the way with a range of benefits designed with you in mind. Some of our favourites include...

- Flexibility to work from home

- Stock options that ensure your share in our success

- Extra recharge days on top of your annual vacation

- Extensive medical, dental, and vision insurance to ensure you’re feeling great physically and mentally

- Learning and Development & Health and Sports budget that you are free to tailor to your own needs

- Four weeks of fully paid sabbatical leave after reaching your 5th work anniversary

We are an Equal Opportunities employer committed to a diverse and representative team. Different opinions, perspectives, and personalities push us forward. We want to hear from people who are passionate about their work and align with our values. Regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability. We also know the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates - so rest assured, whoever you are, we want to hear from you!

jobs.title: Senior Director of Product Marketing
jobs.description:
About Veriff

Veriff guarantees trust for some of the largest consumer platforms in the world. We're known for identity verification, but that is only where we started. Every verification we run strengthens the Veriff Network, a trust layer that gets smarter with each check. On top of it, we're building a portfolio of products that help platforms know who, and what, they're dealing with at global scale.

The market hasn't caught up with that story yet. We need someone to change that.

The role

You'll lead product marketing at Veriff, and your first mandate is to reposition the company. Today we're seen mainly as an identity verification vendor. We need the market to see the truth: That Veriff is a trust platform behind the world's largest consumer brands. You'll own positioning, messaging, launches, and sales enablement across our portfolio.

This is a hands-on role. You'll write much of the work yourself, including positioning docs, launch plans, pitch narratives, and battlecards, working closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing. You'll start with a small team and grow it as our rebuilt sales organization gains traction.

We're looking for someone who will push us. If you have a strong point of view, like to take smart risks, and would rather make a leadership team a little uncomfortable than blend into the category, keep reading.

What you'll do

- Lead Veriff's repositioning. Define how the company, the Veriff Network, and our portfolio are positioned, and get the leadership team, sales team, and market behind it.

- Run product launches end to end, making each one strengthen the company story. Work within a structured annual launch cadence and industry event calendar.

- Equip our sales team to win enterprise deals with pitch narratives, discovery guides, battlecards, and objection handling. Stay close enough to deals to know what's working, and fix what isn't.

- Build competitive and market intelligence, and turn win/loss insight into sharper positioning and better product strategy.

- Partner with Product on pricing, packaging, and roadmap narrative, and with Marketing and Communications on campaigns and external storytelling.

- Develop our PMM team, and shape when and how it grows.

What we're looking for

- 8+ years in product marketing, including time leading the function or a significant part of it, ideally in technical B2B businesses such as AI, SaaS, identity, fraud, payments, security, or API-first companies.

- A strong point of view, and a track record of acting on it. You've pushed a differentiated positioning through real internal resistance, and you can show what it achieved.

- Bold but honest. In a business where trust is the product, you make ambitious claims you can prove.

- Craft. You've personally written positioning for technical products that works for technical and business buyers alike, and you can make a complex trust topic land in one slide.

- Proven impact on sales outcomes. You've built enablement that measurably moved conversion, win rates, or deal velocity.

- Technical curiosity. You enjoy understanding how sophisticated AI products actually work, so you can explain them in a way nobody else can.

- A bias for action. You'd rather write the first draft than wait for direction, and you also enjoy developing the people around you.

Nice to have

- Familiarity with regulated industries (financial services, gaming, marketplaces) or developer-led go-to-market motions.

Why Veriff?

We are the preferred identity verification platform partner for the world’s most innovative growth-driven organizations helping conveniently verify and safeguard users anywhere in the world. We support the broadest number of identity documents from nearly every country and territory in the world - and this is continually increasing! With a diverse team in the United States, United Kingdom, Spain, Brazil, and Estonia, as well as robust backing and funding from investors including Accel, Alkeon, IVP, Tiger Capital, and Y Combinator, we’re dedicated to helping businesses and individuals build a safer and more secure world. We strive to be the benchmark for trust online, and we take pride in being a positive force.

Compensation:

The base salary for this role is $200,000 - $220,000 per year.  Please note that our salary ranges are based on current market data and the offered compensation may vary based on experience, skills, location, and other factors permitted by law

When you join Team Veriff, we offer you the opportunity to have a real impact and advance your career, while looking after you along the way with a range of benefits designed with you in mind. Some of our favorites include…

- Flexibility to work from home

- Stock options that ensure your share in our success

- Extra recharge days on top of your annual vacation

- Extensive medical, dental, and vision insurance to ensure you’re feeling great physically and mentally

- Learning and Development and Health and Sports budget that you are free to tailor to your own needs

- Four weeks of fully paid sabbatical leave after reaching your 5th work anniversary

jobs.title: Senior Technical Product Manager (Biometric Authentication)
jobs.description:
Veriff is building the foundational trust layer of the internet, empowering people to safely and privately prove they are who they say they are. Our identity verification platform powers onboarding and authentication for some of the world's largest marketplaces, fintechs, and platforms. Biometric Authentication is our second-largest product, and it's how we move customers from one-time identity checks to continuous, lifecycle-long trust.

THE OPPORTUNITY
Biometric Authentication turns every verified user into an ongoing, secure relationship: silent re-verification, step-up authentication, and fraud prevention at the moments that matter. The product runs in production at enterprise scale, with real cost, conversion, and latency consequences for major customers.

As this product has grown into a multi-product area, we're hiring a Senior PM to take primary ownership of Biometric Authentication: driving customer research, competitive roadmap strategy, and pricing, in close partnership with machine learning, engineering, design, sales, and GTM. In this role, you'll be expected to operate autonomously with low management overhead, default to cross-functional collaboration, and are comfortable experimenting and shipping fast. You'll bring enough context and judgement to make commercial trade-offs without waiting for direction. You'll be at your best in ambiguous, fast-moving environments and on distributed, international teams.

This is a role for a PM who treats adoption, conversion, and revenue as their own problem, not one who manages a feature backlog and waits for commercial direction.

You’ll help us protect honest people online by:

- Own the product end-to-end. Take primary ownership of Biometric Authentication: strategy, roadmap, and execution — across a cross-functional squad of ML, engineering, and design.

- Own a commercial metric. Pick up a revenue, adoption, or conversion metric, diagnose the gap, and design the customer research and process changes to close it alongside sales and GTM.

- Make decisions at scale. Reason about trade-offs in cost, conversion, and latency against live enterprise contracts, in real production conditions, on a regular basis.

- Run a tight customer-feedback loop. Turn enterprise customer feedback into a prioritized, defensible roadmap.

- Own competitive positioning and pricing. Track the biometric and identity landscape and shape packaging and pricing grounded in real unit economics.

- Operate with high agency. Get to independent operation within ~60 days and start clearing the highest-impact work early.

You are the right future Veriffian for the job if you have:

- A technical background and fluent with technical systems: distributed transactional systems, machine learning, operational metrics, COGS, and SDK delivery. (Ability to program is a plus; you won't be building ML models but you should be able to do query, debug and do root cause analysis independently)

- Experience thriving in a scale-up: high ambiguity, fast pace, and challenging environments.

- Strong understanding of B2B2C user experience: fluency in the end-user experience inside a business product.

- ~5+ years of product management experience.

- Experience in fintech or marketplace products.

- Background in authentication, security, or identity.

- Ability to program is a plus; you won't be building ML models but you should be able to do query, debug and do root cause analysis independently)

- Previous Software Engineering / Data Science development experience
